mods.name: bead-claim-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, if Claude edited a file and no bead is in progress, one toast per session to claim or create one. Reads with bd count, and says nothing without bd or a beads project.

mods.name: bead-commit-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, if a git commit named no bead id while a bead is in progress, one toast to name it. Reads with bd count and bd where, and says nothing without bd or a beads project.
